subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: After the non-interactive persistence bug is fixed, should OpenClaw accept this provider-owned `*.ghe.com` auth/config boundary inside the bundled `github-copilot` provider?
rationale: The implementation changes where GitHub OAuth and Copilot API tokens are sent and adds env/config/auth-method surface; prior maintainer-lane comments support the direction, but final owner/security acceptance is still a human boundary decision.

options.title: Fix the headless path, then land
options.body: Persist or clear `githubDomain` consistently in non-interactive auth, rerun targeted proof, and land after owner/security acceptance of the bounded provider-owned surface.

options.title: Keep only interactive tenant auth
options.body: Narrow or document away the headless/env persistence claim if maintainers do not want non-interactive setup to become a persisted tenant-routing path.

options.title: Reject bundled tenant routing
options.body: Close this PR and keep the remaining GHE work outside core if maintainers decide even bounded Copilot tenant routing should not live in the bundled provider.

recommendation.title: Fix the headless path, then land
recommendation.body: Persist or clear `githubDomain` consistently in non-interactive auth, rerun targeted proof, and land after owner/security acceptance of the bounded provider-owned surface.

likelyOwner.reason: PR discussion names owner direction from this handle, and current source history points to recent work on the Copilot provider/auth files.
